title: 雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工~Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation
focus: 雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度~Double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability
summary: 雙護盾可讓切削與管片組裝在不同機構上進行，但並行能力依賴岩壁提供可靠反力、伸縮行程和後勤同步。本課由接觸承壓、軸向推力、循環時間進到擠壓岩與偏轉判讀，將設備能力、地層限制及觀測證據分開列帳。所有數字為教學假設，結論是辨識需要停點審查的條件，不是掘進機操作參數。~A double shield can separate excavation from segment assembly, but concurrent work depends on a reliable rock reaction, available telescopic travel and synchronized logistics. This course follows contact stress, axial thrust and cycle time into squeezing-ground and steering interpretations. Machine capability, ground limitations and observed evidence are recorded separately. All numerical inputs are teaching assumptions; the outcome identifies conditions requiring engineering review rather than machine operating parameters.
history: 國際隧協以反力作用於岩壁或已組襯砌來區分雙護盾的工作路徑，海瑞克公開產品摘要則說明前後盾與伸縮構造。二〇〇九年美國公路隧道手冊提供土建背景，二〇一四年Stepney Green論文可作不同支護序列的對照，二〇一六年營運的聖哥達基線隧道提供深埋岩體環境背景。此處未聲稱這些案例均採雙護盾，學習重點是反力路徑如何改變檢查責任。~ITA distinguishes double-shield reaction through rock walls or installed lining, while the public Herrenknecht summary identifies the shield and telescopic arrangement. The 2009 FHWA manual provides civil-engineering context. The 2014 Stepney Green paper supplies a contrasting support sequence, and Gotthard entering operation in 2016 provides a deep-rock setting. These examples are not all presented as double-shield projects. The historical comparison asks how a changed reaction path changes the evidence and responsibility needed for approval.

units.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束~Telescopic travel and cycle constraint
units.anchor: 伸縮行程與循環約束~Telescopic travel and cycle constraint
units.mechanism: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。~The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits. Nominal maximum extension is not entirely available for production. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.
units.verify: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。~Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position. Plot ring boundaries and regripping on a shared clock. If end reserve differs from the design assumption, review the cycle before treating additional thrust as a remedy for insufficient travel.
units.failure: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。~A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.
units.misconception: 伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。~Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
units.practice: 每一班以共同環號保存行程零點、餘量和定位事件；機械工程師確認傳感器與端點保護，施工主管確認循環可行後才接受新的時間預算。~Keep travel zero, reserve and positioning events under the same ring identifier each shift. The mechanical engineer verifies instrumentation and end protection; the construction lead confirms cycle feasibility before accepting a revised time budget.

units.title: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁~Gripper contact and local rock wall
units.anchor: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁~Gripper contact and local rock wall
units.mechanism: 撐靴把推進反力傳入有限的岩壁接觸區，平均接觸壓力與局部節理幾何共同影響反力可靠度。總力相同時，真實接觸面積變小會放大局部壓力，完整試體強度不能直接代表破碎岩壁。 假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。~Grippers transmit reaction through a finite rock-wall contact. Average pressure and local discontinuity geometry jointly affect reliability. At fixed force, a smaller effective contact increases local pressure; intact specimen strength does not directly characterize a fractured wall. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.
units.verify: 將撐靴壓力與經校正有效缸面積換算的力，和可接近區域的岩壁裂隙記錄對照；比較左右側滑移與壓力波形，不從單一壓力尖峰推定承載力，接觸區狀況須由地質與機械人員共同判讀。~Compare force derived from calibrated cylinder pressure and effective area with accessible wall discontinuity records. Examine left-right slip and pressure histories together. A single pressure peak does not establish capacity; geological and mechanical reviewers must interpret contact conditions jointly.
units.failure: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。~Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.
units.misconception: 完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。~High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.
units.practice: 接觸面積只採有證據的估計值，記錄被遮蔽區域的不確定性；地質工程師審查節理與剝落後，由設備負責人依核准程序判斷反力路徑是否可用。~Use evidence-based contact-area estimates and record uncertainty in hidden zones. After the geologist reviews joints and spalling, the equipment lead assesses the reaction path using the approved procedure rather than the classroom pressure estimate.

units.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離~Reaction friction versus demand
units.anchor: 反力摩擦與需求分離~Reaction friction versus demand
units.mechanism: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。 假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。~A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque. Demand and resistance must first be resolved in the same direction. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.
units.verify: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。~Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Annotate torque changes, contact condition and wall observations. If the ratio changes materially with a small coefficient variation, provide a sensitivity table for designer review.
units.failure: 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。~Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.
units.misconception: 摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。~A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
units.practice: 把μ的來源和替代範圍列為模型輸入，不允許用觀察到的最大值當永久保證；任何操作模式變更均須設備與地工主管共同審核。~Record the source and alternative range of μ as model inputs. An observed maximum is not a permanent guarantee. Equipment and geotechnical leads must jointly review any proposed operating-mode change.

units.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓~Lining reaction and local bearing
units.anchor: 襯砌反力與局部承壓~Lining reaction and local bearing
units.mechanism: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。 假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。~When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.
units.verify: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。~Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Plot maximum shoe force separately from the mean. Crack and contact-mark records test the equal-share assumption; localized damage must be referred to the segment designer rather than averaged away.
units.failure: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。~Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.
units.misconception: 只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。~Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
units.practice: 模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。~A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.

units.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環~Parallel tasks and critical cycle
units.anchor: 並行工序與關鍵循環~Parallel tasks and critical cycle
units.mechanism: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。 假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。~For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional. Concurrent mechanics cannot produce useful advance when supply logistics fail to match the required rhythm. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.
units.verify: 用共同時鐘標註切削、組環、定位、等料和故障事件，抽查同時作業是否真的重疊；將理想循環與完整班次分開比較，統計缺漏不能自動歸入掘進時間，班次主管須簽認事件分類。~Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock. Verify that claimed concurrent activities actually overlap. Compare the ideal cycle separately from the whole shift; missing records cannot automatically become cutting time, and the shift lead must approve event classifications.
units.failure: 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。~Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem.
units.misconception: 兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。~Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
units.practice: 保留原始事件和重疊判定規則，另做組環時間增加的情境分析；改善方案由施工與後勤主管共同核對，不能只報告刀盤切削速度。~Preserve raw events and overlap rules, and analyze a longer assembly-duration scenario. Construction and logistics leads jointly review improvements; cutterhead cutting speed alone is not an adequate production report.

units.title: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力~Shield contact and squeezing resistance
units.anchor: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力~Shield contact and squeezing resistance
units.mechanism: 擠壓岩體可能在盾殼周圍建立長距離接觸，摩擦阻力取決於壓力、接觸長度和摩擦係數。圓周均壓假設可示範尺度效應，但實際接觸斑塊及時間演化需要另行分析。 假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。~Squeezing ground can establish contact over a long shield length. Resistance depends on pressure, contact length and friction. Uniform circumferential pressure demonstrates scaling, but real contact patches and their evolution with time require separate analysis. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN. Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.
units.verify: 比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。~Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime. Separate geological change from uncertain contact length. Calculate ranges using several pressure and friction assumptions; a single thrust observation cannot uniquely identify ground pressure, so the designer reviews identifiability.
units.failure: 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。~Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped.
units.misconception: 停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。~Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
units.practice: 停機交接另列收斂趨勢、接觸不確定性與恢復前審查項；若觀測超出原假設，由地工設計者和設備主管檢討後續方案，課堂摩擦值不作啟動命令。~A shutdown handover lists convergence trends, uncertain contact and pre-restart reviews. If observations depart from assumptions, the geotechnical designer and equipment lead reconsider the plan. Classroom friction estimates never serve as restart commands.

units.title: 姿態差與推力偏心~Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity
units.anchor: 姿態差與推力偏心~Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity
units.mechanism: 左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。導向評估還要連接盾殼淨空、線形曲率以及後方環體位置。 假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。 單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。~Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction. Small-angle geometry describes differential movement but does not show that the ground permits the attitude. Steering interpretation must also consider shield clearance, alignment curvature and the positions of completed rings. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle. A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle.
units.verify: 用全站儀姿態、左右行程計和環面測量交叉核對，先確認坐標方向與時間一致；若角度差超過儀器不確定度，追查滑移或接觸偏心，不能只調整顯示零點讓兩組數字吻合。~Cross-check survey attitude, left-right travel transducers and ring-face measurements after confirming coordinate signs and timing. When disagreement exceeds instrumental uncertainty, investigate slip or eccentric contact; changing display zeros merely to align the readings is not an acceptable reconciliation.
units.failure: 單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。~A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist.
units.misconception: 左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。~Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
units.practice: 姿態報告保留原始坐標、基距與校正紀錄，異常先由測量人員獨立複測；導向決策須交由獲授權的機械與線形負責人評估。~Retain raw coordinates, baseline dimensions and calibration records in attitude reports. Survey staff independently remeasure anomalies; authorized mechanical and alignment leads assess any steering decision using the full evidence.

units.title: 切削能量與岩況判讀~Cutting energy and ground interpretation
units.anchor: 切削能量與岩況判讀~Cutting energy and ground interpretation
units.mechanism: 機械能與開挖體積的比值可用於比較同一設備在不同環段的表現，但它同時受刀具、岩性、轉速與停機分類影響。比能升高不是岩石強度增加的唯一證據，輸入功率也不等於純破岩功率。 假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。~Mechanical energy per excavated volume can compare sections on one machine, but cutters, geology, speed and downtime classification all influence it. Higher specific energy is not unique evidence of stronger rock, and input power is not identical to power used in fragmentation. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses. Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses.
units.verify: 將功率積分時段對準實際開挖體積與刀具紀錄，剔除待機但保留原分類；比較鄰環粒徑、地質面誌及轉矩波形，只有多項證據一致才討論岩況變化，必要時列出其他可能原因。~Align the power integration window with measured excavation and cutter records. Separate standby while retaining original event categories. Compare neighboring muck grading, geological logs and torque histories; discuss changed ground only when several observations agree, and document plausible alternatives.
units.failure: 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。~Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change.
units.misconception: 單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。~An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.
units.practice: 報告明示功率邊界是電力、軸功或估算破岩能，保持跨環比較一致；地質與機械分析分別簽認，避免把統計相關當作獨立因果證明。~State whether the power boundary is electrical input, shaft work or estimated fragmentation energy, keeping comparisons consistent. Geological and mechanical reviewers sign separately so that statistical association is not treated as independent causal proof.

units.title: 停機利用率與敏感度~Downtime utilization and sensitivity
units.anchor: 停機利用率與敏感度~Downtime utilization and sensitivity
units.mechanism: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。分開排程時數與有效切削時數，才能比較維修和供料改善的實際作用，也避免重複扣除同一損失。 假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。~Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. Utilization must not be applied again to hours already excluding downtime. Separating scheduled hours from active hours allows meaningful maintenance and supply comparisons without counting the same loss twice. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day.
units.verify: 以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。~Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records. Classify delays and check that accounted hours match scheduled hours. Resolve overlapping categories before comparing utilization or attributing improvement to maintenance.
units.failure: 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。~Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.
units.misconception: 只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。~Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
units.practice: 交接文件保留排程、有效時間和原因分類三欄，另附利用率敏感度而非單一保證進尺；工期承諾須由計畫主管結合地質與供應限制審定。~Keep scheduled time, active time and delay categories as separate handover fields. Supply utilization sensitivity rather than one guaranteed rate. The planning lead evaluates schedule commitments against geological and supply constraints.

units.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理~Ring traceability and missing observations
units.anchor: 環號追溯與缺測處理~Ring traceability and missing observations
units.mechanism: 機械、地質與襯砌資料必須透過環號和共同時間串接，才能分辨同一事件前後的因果順序。資料完整率只衡量可追溯程度，不能取代內容正確性；缺測區間更不能默認機器狀態正常。 假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。~Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order. Completeness measures traceability rather than correctness. Missing intervals cannot be presumed normal, particularly when they coincide with mode changes or unusual loading. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item. A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Retaining only summary plots after handover makes later reconstruction of the anomaly difficult.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item.
units.verify: 抽查環號、時鐘偏差、原始檔與簽認版本是否可互相回溯，優先檢視模式切換及推力異常附近的缺測；每個未閉合事件列出責任人、替代證據和下一次審查，不把補寫摘要當作原始量測。~Audit ring identifiers, clock offsets, raw files and signed versions for traceability. Prioritize missing records near mode changes or abnormal thrust. Assign each unresolved event an owner, alternative evidence and review date; a retrospective summary is not an original measurement.
units.failure: 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。~A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Retaining only summary plots after handover makes later reconstruction of the anomaly difficult.
units.misconception: 資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。~A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
units.practice: 將未閉合事件獨立列為交接清單，保存不可覆寫的原始版本與修訂理由；設備、地質和品質負責人共同簽認資料限制後完成交接。~List unresolved events separately at handover and retain immutable originals with reasons for revisions. Equipment, geological and quality leads jointly acknowledge data limitations before closing the handover record.

example: 以下原創算例針對雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。~This original worked example examines double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.
